summary: Lineage entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Lineage II
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows Lineage II service branch with server/account documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official Windows client for the selected region/service branch

primary.version: Current official Lineage II / Aden regional service
primary.why: Lineage II is a Windows MMORPG and the official NCSoft regional clients remain the content authority. Because the game is live and region/service-split, archive state depends on chosen service, server, account, class, and current update.
primary.how_to_play: Use an official Lineage II regional Windows client. Record service branch such as Live/Classic/Aden where applicable, server, character/class, account state, monetization state, clan/PvP state, and update date.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge mobile Lineage titles into this entry. Record region/service branch and update state.

entries.title: Lineage
entries.definitive_edition: Current official NCSoft regional client/service, with region and server state documented

emulation.notes: Use official client/service where available; private servers are not the primary archive route.

primary.version: Current official Lineage regional service / Lineage Remastered branch where available
primary.why: Lineage is a live/regional MMORPG whose Western service shut down in 2011, while official NCSoft service remains tied to regional clients and launchers. The archive route must name the region, server, account, and update state instead of treating the 1998 game as a static offline artifact.
primary.how_to_play: Use an official NCSoft/PURPLE regional client where available. Record region/service, client/build, server, account state, class, blood pledge/clan state, monetization, PvP/castle siege access, and whether the original Western service closure affects coverage.

secondary.exclusive_content: Historical launch and now-closed Western route
secondary.what_to_play: Document as history unless a preserved client/server state is available.
secondary.why: The North American service closure makes current official access region-dependent.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record region, build, server, account, monetization, clan/PvP state, and service-closure limitations.
